findings.explanation: This clause requires you to perform unspecified additional work without guaranteed extra pay whenever the company considers it necessary, and there is no change-order mechanism.
findings.suggested_change: The Contractor shall perform the services described herein, and any additional services requested by the Client shall be set forth in a written change order specifying the agreed scope and additional compensation.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, thank you for sending over the contract. Before signing the agreement, I would like to propose a small adjustment. - Regarding the additional services, the relevant clause requires performing unspecified extra work without guaranteed compensation and lacks a change-order mechanism; I propose modifying it so that any additional services requested are set forth in a written change order specifying the agreed scope and additional compensation. Thank you for your time and flexibility.
